correctness.rationale: PASS. For B_{a,b,c} with L1 shortest-path metric, coordinatewise clamping from a larger equal cube is 1-Lipschitz and simplicial at every scale. Gupta–Sarkar–Shukla Thm 4.13 proves larger equal-cube scale-two Rips wedge of S³; its retract has only free H3 and no low homotopy, so by Hurewicz/Whitehead it is a wedge of S³. Thm 3.15 gives contractibility for r>=3, inherited under retraction. Every diameter≤2 clique with coordinate width two has an extreme pair at distance two and a unique midpoint; insertion/deletion of midpoint reverses simplex sign and preserves exact width. Local remaining width coefficients γ=(1,-1,1,-2), hence χ=1-abc, yielding exactly abc spheres. Cube fundamental classes have independent integral clamping evaluations (diagonal ±1) and split rank abc homology, thus an integral basis. Scale-one graph has E-N+1 independent 1-cycles; degree separation yields stated all-field intervals. Independent enumeration of all cliques of the 27-point 3x3x3 Manhattan graph confirmed γ values after translation multiplicities and zero width-two contributions. Finite check is corroborative, not general proof.
